title: Network sprint: show up where they post
purpose: Daily habits: connect, comment, save the best posts, post twice a week.
why: LinkedIn's recruiter tools rank on activity and engagement as well as skills. Thoughtful comments start conversations and teach you what this space responds to.
evidence: Saved posts and engagement results brought to the weekly call.

modules.title: Write posts that sound like you

tasks.title: Follow or connect with relevant people
Leave a substantive comment (observation, real question, or extend their idea, ending with a question)
tasks.done_when: 3 comments a day that could start a conversation.

tasks.title: Save an unusually good post with one sentence: why you stopped, the central idea, why people responded
tasks.done_when: 1–2 saved a day, each with its sentence.

tasks.title: Publish an original post in the style of the best ones you saved
Bring the saved posts and engagement results to the call
tasks.done_when: Saved posts doc and your best comment threads linked here.
